description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Daru Mender, adding {W}.
When Daru Mender dies, Yedora triggers, returning Daru Mender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Daru Mender by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Daru Mender's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
